director.name: 让-克劳德·卢梭 Jean-Claude Rousseau

introduction: The acousmatic situation consists of placing the speaker behind a curtain in order to only perceive his voice without being distracted by his image. Jean-Claude Rousseau, like Doctor Mabuse, might have placed a pianist behind the tapestry. When his silhouette fills the lens and he lets out some words, is he addressing the perceived animal or, by remaining behind the screen, would he like to invite us into this charming interior?
